note: Larkspur's rule for chapter 7, set by Mira and the shop's owner: team choices, not industry figures.
rule: In every disaster, lose at most 120 orders and be back within 10 hours; then spend as little a week as you can.

reasons.every: More copies lose less work, and cost more tape.
reasons.kind: Incremental tapes are cheap, but a restore reads every link.
reasons.places: The week brings a dead disk, a fire and ransomware.
